input: Get a referral letter from my GP for a specialist

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which type of specialist is needed determines what medical information the GP must include and whether a specific referral pathway applies.
The referral could be for the user themselves or someone they care for, which affects who needs to attend the appointment and who communicates with the GP.
Whether the user has already spoken to their GP or is starting from scratch changes the very next action — booking an appointment vs. following up.
Urgency level (routine vs. urgent) shapes the timeline and the approach — e.g., requesting an emergency slot vs. a standard consultation.
The preferred method of contacting the GP (phone, online portal, in-person) determines the immediate next step the user needs to take.
Whether the user has a preferred specialist or clinic in mind affects what information they need to bring to the GP and how the letter should be addressed.
Understanding whether the goal is just getting the letter or also booking the specialist appointment defines when this task is truly complete.

gold.taskTitle: Get a GP referral letter for a specialist
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to obtain a referral letter from their general practitioner to see a medical specialist.

questions.title: Which type of specialist do you need a referral to?
questions.description: Identify the medical specialty (e.g., cardiologist, dermatologist, orthopaedic surgeon) so the correct referral pathway and required information are clear.

questions.title: Is this referral for yourself or someone else?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is the patient or acting on behalf of another person, such as a child or elderly relative.

questions.title: Have you already spoken to your GP about this referral?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a first conversation with the GP or a follow-up to an existing discussion, to identify the correct next action.

questions.title: How urgently do you need to see the specialist?
questions.description: Establish whether this is a routine, soon, or urgent referral, as this affects the timeline and how the GP appointment should be framed.

questions.title: How do you usually contact or book with your GP?
questions.description: Identify the available contact method — phone, online portal, walk-in — so the immediate next step can be tailored accordingly.

questions.title: Do you have a specific specialist or clinic in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preferred provider, which affects what details they need to supply to the GP for the letter to be addressed correctly.

questions.title: Is your goal just the letter, or also booking the specialist?
questions.description: Clarify the full scope of the task — whether success means obtaining the referral letter alone, or also securing and attending the specialist appointment.
